description: 1. PHASE 1 - SCAN: Agent reads session_log.txt and identifies all tool outputs. It must correctly classify: (a) the kubectl pods output as 'large' because it exceeds 50 lines, (b) the helm diff output as 'large' because it exceeds 2000 characters, (c) the two 'ls' outputs as redundant/discardable duplicates, (d) the kubectl version output as small but containing a key fact (server still on 1.24.17). 2. PHASE 2 - EXTRACT: Agent must APPEND (not overwrite) new facts to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md using today's actual date. The existing content ('EKS 1.29', 's3://corp-terraform-state/prod', 'Helm preference') must survive. New entries must include: critical endpoints (redis-prod.internal.corp, db-prod.internal.corp, prometheus endpoint), the ci-bot ClusterRoleBinding error+resolution, and the nginx vs ALB decision with Q3 deferral rationale. 3. PHASE 3 - CHECKLIST: Agent generates a structured checklist with exact proprietary formatting: 📋 header, ━━━ box-drawing dividers, 📊 statistics section (tool call count, large output count >=2, safe-to-compress count), 💾 extracted memory section with [+] markers, ⚠️ warnings if applicable, and ✅ final recommendation. The checklist must reference 'big block outputs' threshold. 4. PHASE 4 - NO AUTO COMPACT: Agent must NOT claim to have executed /compact. It should only suggest the user confirm before proceeding with compression.
